synthesizedFacts.fact: Loose skin after weight loss is primarily due to the skin's inability to retract after being stretched by excess weight.
Collagen and elastin are critical proteins in the dermis that provide skin structure and elasticity.
Gradual weight loss, strength training, and proper hydration can help minimize loose skin.
Age, genetics, and the duration of being overweight are significant factors influencing skin elasticity post-weight loss.
